en.title: A Systematic Approach to Constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains
en.hook: Explore a scalable system for extracting and structuring semiconductor supply chain risks and opportunities.
key_takeaways: Analyzes geopolitical and technological risks in supply chains
Scalable automated extraction and structuring of risk data
Systematizes opportunities and threats into a clear matrix

将机遇与威胁因素转化为系统化矩阵
